subject: [PATCH v3 03/12] nfsd: count a delegation in cl_delegs_in_recall only once

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFS server where a delegation is counted multiple times when recalled, leading to incorrect client status and preventing courtesy clients from being re-established. The fix involves checking if the recall has already been processed before incrementing the count of delegations in recall, ensuring that nfsd_change_deleg_cb() decrements the count only once at F_UNLCK. This prevents a leaked count that keeps nfs4_anylock_blockers() true and blocks clients from becoming courtesy clients again.
